g.text: ARDOR PROFESSIONAL AUDIO + CONTROL I/O FOR RASPBERRY PI / CODEC ZERO
Rev B — fail-safe mute, bipolar audio ESD, protected guitar/line/amp, isolated MIDI, expression ADC
GPIO HEADER / PIN ALLOCATION / FUSED 5 V ENTRY
Use isolated-bushing audio jacks. Bond CHASSIS at J9; fit R31 only after hum/EMC verification.
2. HIGH-Z GUITAR INPUT → CODEC ZERO AUX IN
3A. CODEC ZERO AUX OUT → STEREO LINE + MONO GUITAR AMP
U1 is one OPA4377AIPWR in TSSOP-14; place 100nF directly at pins 4 and 11.
Codec P1/P2 pin order (square pin 1): LEFT, GND, RIGHT, GND. AUX maximum: 1 V RMS.
3B. FAIL-SAFE STEREO LINE + MONO GUITAR AMP OUTPUTS
MIDI cable side is isolated: never join MIDI_TIP/RING/SHIELD to AGND/DGND. No extra I2C pull-ups fitted.
GPIO10 HIGH closes K1/K2 only after codec clocks and bias are stable; GPIO10 defaults LOW at reset.
